title: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.138 does not properly validate a backup storage…
description: The WPvivid Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin versions prior to 0.9.138 contains a vulnerability where it does not properly validate backup storage directory paths. This flaw allows an administrator to create directories and write files outside the intended backup location through path traversal.
